chunks: And from him, from al-Nadr, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I said to him, 'We have a mu'adhdhin who calls the adhan at night.' He said, 'Indeed, that benefits the neighbors because of their rising for prayer. As for the Sunnah, the call is made with the rising of dawn, and between the adhan and the iqamah there are only two rak'at.'

key_terms.يُؤَذِّنُ بِاللَّيْلِ: calling the adhan at night (before dawn)

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between the night adhan and the dawn adhan according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) distinguishes between the practical utility of the pre-dawn adhan for waking neighbors and the ideal Sunnah of performing the call at the precise moment of true dawn (Fajr al-Sadiq). This narration underscores the Shia emphasis on aligning ritual timing with astronomical reality, while acknowledging the flexibility of the night adhan as a preparatory measure rather than the primary liturgical act.
